title: Spot the Flaw: Quality & Testing Edition
brief: This signup model already declares column quality rules that will ship as dbt and ODCS tests. But two of those rules are broken: a numeric range that no value can satisfy, and a regex pattern that will not compile (it would crash the generated test). One rule on dim_country is correct — leave it alone. Fix the two broken rules in the column editor's Quality rules section, then re-validate.

entities.description: User signups with declared quality assertions.

columns.name: promo_code
columns.description: Optional promotion code used at signup.

expected_flaws.hint: A range test that no value can pass is worse than no test. Look at age's min vs max.
expected_flaws.fix: In the column editor's Quality rules, set a sane range (e.g. min 13, max 120) so min <= max.

expected_flaws.hint: A pattern that won't compile crashes the generated dbt test. One regex is missing a closing parenthesis.
expected_flaws.fix: Fix the promo_code regex so it compiles, e.g. '^[A-Z]{4}$'.

solution_notes: The clean model fixes age's contradictory range (min 150 > max 18) to a satisfiable one and repairs the promo_code regex so it compiles. dim_country.iso_code's '^[A-Z]{2}$' is already correct and must be left untouched — a well-formed rule produces no lint. After the fixes, re-validation shows no INVALID_RANGE or INVALID_REGEX, and the exported dbt_expectations / ODCS quality assertions are all valid.
